text:
maria r.: Cascade Systems blocked — private deploy in ap-southeast-1 failing during node init. agent pod crashes when loading redwood-net-bridge. they need an architecture quick-check before Friday go-live. @ajay @samir can you take?
ajay patel: I'm available. what are the symptoms? kernel oops or user-space panic?
maria r.: Logs show module init error + iptables nft mismatch. snippet they sent: 
```
ERROR: redwood-net-bridge: init failed - unknown symbol: register_netdevice
WARNING: iptables-nft vs iptables-legacy mismatch
```
They mentioned custom Mellanox firmware and Ubuntu 18.04 nodes.
samir khan: older distro + custom NIC firmware explains missing symbols. do they enforce secureboot? customer says our signed kmod was rejected.
heather liu: secureboot + custom kernel builds are common in regulated infra. we should ask for `dmesg` and `modinfo redwood-net-bridge`. also confirm `uname -a` and whether they have out-of-tree kernels.
ajay patel: plan: 1) collect uname/modinfo/dmesg; 2) try hostNetwork fallback to bypass kernel module; 3) if fallback works, allow a temporary canary go-live. can someone paste the helm patch for fallback?
enmaria r.: helm patch used in staging: 
```yaml
agent:
  kmodEnabled: false
  hostNetwork: true
```
Applying to a single canary node now.
deploy-bot: marketplace:image-sign-check started for redwood/cascade-agent:2026.03 sha:abc1234
samir khan: I'll reach out to Cascade infra contact Jenna O. and spin up a 30m debug call in 20m. adding @ajay @maria.
jenna o.: thanks team. i've collected `uname -a` and dmesg, sharing on the call. we enforce custom secureboot keys; loading unsigned modules is blocked.
ajay patel: ok, two parallel tracks: short-term hostNetwork fallback for go-live, long-term we need signed module accepted by customer's secureboot policy or a userspace implementation. ask for `modinfo` output and kernel version string.
heather liu: post-action: update SI checklist to include secureboot verification and distro/kernel compatibility matrix. also document driver firmware compatibility (Mellanox forks).
maria r.: canary hostNetwork smoke passed — agent runs without kmod on canary node. Cascade requests a temporary exception for Friday go-live while we finalize module signing path.
samir khan: noted. set incident INC-243012 for tracking. I'll coordinate with partnerships/legal on exception and with eng-driver team on signing instructions.
ops-bot: created ticket TKT-20260301-01 "cascade: secureboot module acceptance" assigned to eng-runtime.
maria r.: thanks all — will keep this thread updated with the call notes and signed-module plan.
